notes: «وحدثنا سفيان فقال» starts a second isnad of the same saying; its head is written as سفيان only, so the link before him (علي بن عبد الله) is not repeated
«إن إنسانا روى عنك ... ويرفعه أنه قرأ فزع» names another transmitter and a different wording: variant group, never a route; «عنك» is the addressee Sufyan
the answers «قال سمعت عكرمة قال سمعت أبا هريرة» repeat the second route: left out
